findings.reason: publishing the field from the lane document's own writer reaches every stated consumer (gpu-watch's `--live` lane block copies fields, so it still receives it) and keeps one definition of the figure at its owner.
findings.text: §14 computes `availability_percent = 100 × headroom ÷ router_generation_gate.effective_width` inside `live_panel.lane_block`, a consumer of the lane document, although `write_lane_document` is the producer that already holds both inputs and publishes `headroom` and the `router_generation_gate` block. Placing the derivation in the consumer means reckon's lane reader and every orchestrator — the consumers that act on `headroom` — never see the figure (§14 states reckon publishes none), and the semantics of "share of the gate still open" are defined in a second place that can drift from the writer

findings.reason: the section must state in its own text what interface surface it retires or merges, or why nothing can be, since it is the section that moves the CLI option count off zero.
findings.text: the section adds the `--live` flag to `imas-ambix agent watch` (§11's wiring node) and two new public blocks (`lane`, `live`) to the `--json` document and the published `watch.json`, without naming what it retires or merges in the cli_options or public_definitions families, or stating why nothing can be; §5 (removes `--submit`/`--dry-run`) and §12 (removes `DEFAULT_PRICE_PATH`) do account for their surface, so the omission is specific to §11

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §11's `imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py` hides the run-boundary test, the cumulative-histogram median and the receipt-tail reading behind two functions (`lane_block`, `live_block`) that serve both `--live` and the full document; §12's `provider_prices.py` and §9's single `load_estimate` are each one module/function over the behaviour they hide.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 derives `availability_percent` in `imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py` `lane_block`, a consumer that copies the lane document, rather than publishing it from the lane document's owner `imas_ambix/agent/lane.py:650` `write_lane_document`, which is where `headroom` and `router_generation_gate.effective_width` are both produced.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §11 adds the `--live` CLI option and two new published document blocks without naming, in its own text, what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanism it extends for each proposal it makes (counter_run_continues/partitioned_total for §8/§13, the lane document and its 30 s router writer for §11, provider_prices/SiteConfig for §9/§12, reckon's declared-services mechanism for §5), and the code confirms each exists.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the two places the plan does layer over existing machinery (`lane_block` copying the lane document's own fields, and the §11 live window reusing `counter_run_continues`) each state why they copy/extend rather than recompute, and the JSON-document contract §10 uses is the one §11 already publishes.
